# hivelocity_webhook_events (Data Source)

Lists the events a `hivelocity_webhook` can subscribe to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_webhook_events" "all" {}

output "event_names" {
  value = data.hivelocity_webhook_events.all.events[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `events` (List of Object) Available webhook events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
